COLOURS External Pilots Open Call
Proyecto europeo que la convoca: A European Collaborative Cloud for Cultural Heritage – Innovative tools for the study, conservation and restoration of heritage objects
Convocatoria en cascada (fondos europeos repartidos por un proyecto a terceros)
Identificador: HORIZON-CL2-2024-HERITAGE-ECCCH-01-05
Apertura: 2026-11-26
Cierre: 2027-01-27
es_SortDate: 2026-11-26T00:00:00.000+0000
beneficiaryAdministration: Applications may be submitted only via FundingBox Platform . See Terms & Conditions . 
 Selection follows a 6-step process: 
 Eligibility check 
 Pre-scoring (optional) 
 Independent Individual Evaluation based on criteria described in Terms & Conditions 
 Online interview for top-scoring applicants 
 Selection Consensus Meeting to select finalists, based on evaluation, interview, and COLOURS project goals 
 Legal and ethical review of pre-selected projects prior to Sub-Grant Agreement signature
description: COLOURS External Pilots Open Call will select up to 10 projects to use advanced digital tools for color-sensitive artefact restoration. 
 Funding up to €60k (single entities) or €100k (consortia, max €60k/partner) as a lump sum, with technical mentoring over 3 stages of up to 9 months: 
 Stage 1 (Planning, up to 1 month, 10% grant up to €10k), 
 Stage 2 (Preparation, up to 4 months, 45% grant up to €45k), 
 Stage 3 (Testing & Reporting, up to 4 months, 45% grant up to €45k).

callTitle: COLOURS External Pilots Open Call
furtherInformation: Applicants can propose restoration pilots focusing on colour-sensitive heritage objects, address at least one or combine elements across multiple thematic scenarios, using the digital tools from the COLOURS Toolkit. 
 Who can apply: 
 single Cultural Heritage Institutions (CHIs) with in-house conservation teams 
 consortia of a CHI end-user and conservation entity, 
 from EU Member States, OCTs, or Horizon Europe Associated Countries.
